claims: Jessie Buckley won the 2026 Oscar for Best Actress for her role as Agnes in Hamnet.
Jessie Buckley won the Best Actress Oscar at the 98th Academy Awards.
The 98th Academy Awards took place on March 15, 2026.
Jessie Buckley is the first Irish winner of the Oscar for Best Actress.
Rose Byrne was nominated for the 2026 Oscar for Best Actress for If I Had Legs I'd Kick You.
Emma Stone was nominated for the 2026 Oscar for Best Actress for Bugonia.
Kate Hudson was nominated for the 2026 Oscar for Best Actress for Song Sung Blue.
Renate Reinsve was nominated for the 2026 Oscar for Best Actress for Sentimental Value.
Jessie Buckley won at the BAFTAs prior to the 2026 Oscars.
Jessie Buckley won at the Golden Globes prior to the 2026 Oscars.
Jessie Buckley won at the Critics' Choice Awards prior to the 2026 Oscars.
